svg.title: Rivers and drainage basins of Irad
svg.desc: The three closed drainage systems of Irad: the Chu, the Talas and the Syr Darya system, with the deserts that have no surface outflow. Basin divides are approximate. Border of Irad: Kartalar map data. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain); Chu, Talas and Chatkal rivers © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
